answer: One concrete Sybil resistance method for AI agent economies is stake-weighted identity verification, where each agent must lock unique non-transferable resource tokens tied to verifiable on-chain activity histories. Fake accounts cannot replicate the distinct resource footprints of real agents, just as no two wildflower patches on a sunbaked knoll share the exact same pigment mix, and no bad actor can forge the unique activity signature that proves an agent is a legitimate contributor to the network’s shared digital oasis.
